title: Proper projective-line cohomology and restriction to infinity
statement: Let k₀ be a finite field, l a prime distinct from its characteristic, and X a scheme locally of finite type and quasi-compact over Spec k₀. In the native category WeilComplex k₀ l X, let q:P¹_X→X and i:X→P¹_X be the section at infinity [sk-d-lines]. Set G=q* followed by Rq_* [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Let L=q*, R=Rq_*, I=i*, and let e:L⋙I≅Id be the composition comparison from i≫q=id. Define restriction ρ:G→Id by ρ_K=e⁻¹_(Rq_*q*K), then I applied to the counit at q*K, then e_K. All data are actual composites of the pullback-composition isomorphisms and the counit of [lem-sf-derived-weil-pullback-pushforward-adjunction].
